human language. The possibilities are endless. Skill number 4. Computer vision

This skill proves invaluable in areas like autonomous vehicles and security systems.

Emmerce yourself in the world of robots. Learn to design, build, program, and control robots.

With this skill, you'll make informed decisions and gain a competitive edge.
Skill number 7. Automation

Automate repetitive tasks and focus on what truly matters, increasing productivity like never before.
Skill number 8. Cybersecurity
As technology advances, sit as the importance of protecting it.

Be a responsible innovator by understanding the ethical implications of AI.
As we shape the future, we must ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI systems.
So there you have it, the 9 AI skills you need now to stay ahead of 97% of people.
Equip yourself with these skills and unlock a world of endless possibilities.
Thanks for watching, don't forget to subscribe to our channel for more exciting content.
